title: Accolades
description: L'USI conferisce le seguenti onorificenze: Dottorato honoris causa Membro onorario Medaglia dell'Università

blocks.html:
USI confers the following accolades:

  • Honorary Doctorate
  • Honorary Member
  • University Medal

  • Honorary Doctorate

    The Honorary Doctorate - Dottorato honoris causa - is conferred as a way of honouring a distinguished person’s contributions to a specific field or to society in general. This honour is bestowed during the Dies academicus or – in certain cases – on other special occasions.

    Discover more

  • Honorary Member

    The title of Honorary Member of the Università della Svizzera italiana is conferred as a way of honouring persons who "have particularly distinguished themselves for their commitment to supporting USI". This honour is bestowed during the Dies academicus.

    Discover more

  • University Medal

    The University Medal is awarded to those who have made an "important contribution to the development of USI". This honour is bestowed during the Dies academicus.

    Discover more
